question:
Explain:
(i) the principle of working of a transformer
(ii) why a transformer does not work with a steady DC supply

options.A:
(i) A transformer works by self-induction from a steady current.
(ii) It works best with DC because DC gives a constant flux.
options.B:
(i) A transformer works by electrostatic induction between its coils.
(ii) DC gives continuous induced emf because it has fixed polarity.
options.C:
(i) A transformer works by resistance heating in the primary coil.
(ii) DC cannot flow through the secondary coil.
options.D:
(i) A transformer works on mutual induction: AC in the primary produces changing magnetic flux that induces emf in the secondary.
(ii) A steady DC supply gives constant flux after the initial instant, so no continuous emf is induced in the secondary.
